purpose: Initial CPU feasibility experiment, not final benchmark
training: All train positive images; random 3:1 negative-to-positive image sample
validation_and_test: 1000 patients each, stratified by any Pneumonia label; all images for selected patients; no image class balancing
limitations: Training prevalence is deliberately changed; raw probabilities are not population risks.
Patient stratification does not guarantee equal image prevalence.
Small held-out positive counts give uncertain sensitivity and AUPRC estimates.
Do not select a different seed/cohort after inspecting model performance.
No model evaluation or full pilot image acquisition has occurred.
